basic_details.job_title: Hamirpur District Patwari Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline for 21 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Deputy Commissioner (DC) Hamirpur Patwari Recruitment 2026 notification has been released on 21.07.2026 for the re-engagement of retired Patwaris and Kanungos in Hamirpur District, Himachal Pradesh. A total of 21 Patwari vacancies have been announced through the Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026.

important_dates.raw: 21 July 2026 Last Date to Submit Application: 5 August 2026 | Applications received after the last date, or found incomplete, will be rejected and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.

age_limit.age_relaxation: Not mentioned in the official notification

qualification.details: The official notification does not prescribe a separate educational qualification for this re-engagement, since eligibility is based on prior service as a Patwari/Kanungo. However, the prescribed application form requires candidates to furnish details of their 10th, 10+2, Graduate/Post Graduate, and any other qualification, along with the Board/University, school/college name, year of passing, and percentage of marks.

salary_details.details: Retired Patwaris re-engaged against these posts will be paid a monthly remuneration of Rs. 40,000/-. Continuation of medical facilities and reimbursement of medical expenses as admissible to them as a retiree. | The period of engagement will not be counted for any service benefits earned before superannuation.

selection_process: Eligible retired Patwaris/Kanungos will be considered for the post on the recommendation of a committee constituted vide office order No. DRO/Estt/Re-engagement-8234-39 dated 28/12/2023
headed by the Additional Deputy Commissioner
Hamirpur. If applications received exceed the number of vacancies advertised
candidates junior in age will be given preference for engagement against such posts.
how_to_apply: Download or obtain the prescribed application form, "Applications for Re-engaging of Patwari in Hamirpur District."
Fill in personal details: name, father's name, date of birth, date of retirement, permanent home address, and correspondence address.
Mention category (General/SC/ST/OBC) and fill the educational qualification table with examination passed, Board/University, school/college name, year of passing, and marks percentage.
Fill in the year the Patwari exam and Kanungo exam were passed, along with total service in the Revenue Department.
Sign the declaration confirming age (not exceeding 65 years) and that no disciplinary/departmental proceeding is pending.
Attach all relevant supporting documents and certificates along with the application form.
Send the completed application so that it reaches the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Hamirpur (HP) on or before 5 August 2026.
important_instructions: Applications must reach the DC office on or before the last date; postal or courier delays are not the department's responsibility as per the notification's rejection clause. Incomplete applications will be rejected, and no correspondence will be entertained in this regard. This engagement is purely temporary and does not confer any regular service benefit. Candidates should retain a copy of the filled application and all enclosed documents for their records.

Candidates interested in similar opportunities can also explore more Himachal Pradesh Government Jobs and Revenue Department Jobs across the state. Those looking for openings in nearby districts can check Mandi District Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. content_sections.heading: Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh, has officially released the Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026 notification dated 21.07.2026 for the re-engagement of 21 retired Patwaris/Kanungos on a temporary remuneration basis against vacant Patwar Circles in the district. The notification contains complete details regarding vacancies, eligibility criteria, age limit, remuneration, terms and conditions of engagement, selection procedure, required documents, and the offline application process. Eligible retired officials are advised to read the official notification carefully before submitting their application in the prescribed format. Download Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026 Official Notification PDF Hamirpur District Official Website

rows.details: Retired Patwaris/Kanungos of Himachal Pradesh Revenue Department
Not more than 65 years on the date of advertisement
Rs. 40,000/- per month for retired Patwaris
Against vacant Patwar Circles in District Hamirpur (HP)
Offline (application form with documents sent to DC office)

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: 21 July 2026 Last Date to Submit Application: 5 August 2026 Applications received after the last date, or found incomplete, will be rejected and no correspondence in this regard will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur DC Patwari Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 21 (Twenty One) Patwari posts are to be filled through re-engagement of retired Patwaris and Kanungos on a remuneration basis, against vacant Patwar Circles in District Hamirpur (HP). The official notification does not provide a category-wise or reservation-wise breakup of these 21 posts.

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026 Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: The official notification does not prescribe a separate educational qualification for this re-engagement, since eligibility is based on prior service as a Patwari/Kanungo. However, the prescribed application form requires candidates to furnish details of their 10th, 10+2, Graduate/Post Graduate , and any other qualification, along with the Board/University, school/college name, year of passing, and percentage of marks.

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026 Age Limit

rows.details: 65 years (as on the date of advertisement of vacancies)
Not mentioned in the official notification

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur DC Patwari 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Retired Patwaris re-engaged against these posts will be paid a monthly remuneration of Rs. 40,000/- . As per the terms and conditions, they will also be entitled to: One day's casual leave after completing one month of service (no other leave is admissible). TA/DA for official tour duty, at the same rate as applicable to regular counterpart officials at the minimum of the pay scale. Continuation of medical facilities and reimbursement of medical expenses as admissible to them as a retiree. The period of engagement will not be counted for any service benefits earned before superannuation.

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Eligible retired Patwaris/Kanungos will be considered for the post on the recommendation of a committee constituted vide office order No. DRO/Estt/Re-engagement-8234-39 dated 28/12/2023, headed by the Additional Deputy Commissioner, Hamirpur. If applications received exceed the number of vacancies advertised, candidates junior in age will be given preference for engagement against such posts.

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026 Required Documents
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form Proof of date of birth and date of retirement Educational qualification certificates (10th, 10+2, Graduate/Post Graduate, and any other, as applicable) Proof of Patwari exam and Kanungo exam passing year (where applicable) Category certificate (General/SC/ST/OBC), if applicable Proof of total service rendered in the Revenue Department Fitness certificate from a Government Hospital Signed declaration confirming age does not exceed 65 years and no disciplinary proceeding is pending

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Download or obtain the prescribed application form, "Applications for Re-engaging of Patwari in Hamirpur District." Fill in personal details: name, father's name, date of birth, date of retirement, permanent home address, and correspondence address. Mention category (General/SC/ST/OBC) and fill the educational qualification table with examination passed, Board/University, school/college name, year of passing, and marks percentage. Fill in the year the Patwari exam and Kanungo exam were passed, along with total service in the Revenue Department. Sign the declaration confirming age (not exceeding 65 years) and that no disciplinary/departmental proceeding is pending. Attach all relevant supporting documents and certificates along with the application form. Send the completed application so that it reaches the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Hamirpur (HP) on or before 5 August 2026 .

content_sections.heading: Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must reach the DC office on or before the last date; postal or courier delays are not the department's responsibility as per the notification's rejection clause. Incomplete applications will be rejected, and no correspondence will be entertained in this regard. This engagement is purely temporary and does not confer any regular service benefit. Candidates should retain a copy of the filled application and all enclosed documents for their records. faq.question: Q1. Who can apply for the Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only retired Patwaris/Kanungos of the Himachal Pradesh Revenue Department who have rendered a minimum of 5 years of service and have no pending disciplinary proceedings can apply.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in the Hamirpur Patwari re-engagement 2026?
faq.answer: There are 21 (Twenty One) vacant Patwari posts to be filled through re-engagement of retirees.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for the application to reach the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Hamirpur (HP), is 5 August 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Hamirpur Patwari re-engagement post?
faq.answer: Selected retired Patwaris will receive a monthly remuneration of Rs. 40,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Hamirpur DC Patwari Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. How will candidates be selected if applications exceed the vacancies?
faq.answer: If the number of applications exceeds the advertised vacancies, candidates junior in age will be given preference for engagement.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the re-engagement?
faq.answer: Retired Patwaris/Kanungos will initially be re-engaged for 3 months, which may be extended based on performance and requirement, and is liable to be terminated at any time.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the completed application be sent?
faq.answer: The application, along with all relevant supporting documents and certificates, should be sent to the Office of the Deputy Commissioner, Hamirpur, District Hamirpur (HP).
